lyricfall.about: %s (%s). Overtone is MIT licensed; design inspired by SpotifyMusicMod (Kart-Modding, MIT).
lyricfall.btn.demo: Show a sample in front of me
lyricfall.btn.open_folder: Open the folder for own lyrics
lyricfall.btn.reload: Search lyrics for this song again
lyricfall.demo.line.2: Set the position, style and size
lyricfall.demo.line.3: You see everything right away while you tune it
lyricfall.demo.line.6: This line is a bit longer to check how long text wraps by words
lyricfall.demo.title: Track title
lyricfall.err.blocked_host: Request to a disallowed address was blocked: %s
lyricfall.err.net_unreachable: Cannot connect to %s. The site may be blocked by your network: try a VPN or retry later.
lyricfall.hint.accent: Accent color of the settings and of highlighted words.
lyricfall.hint.amll_lyrics: AMLL TTML DB on GitHub: word-by-word karaoke highlighting. The song index is downloaded every few days; only the lyrics file name is requested.
lyricfall.hint.any_app: Off: only Spotify. On: any app shown in the Windows media overlay, e.g. YouTube in the browser.
lyricfall.hint.background: How opaque the background panel is.
lyricfall.hint.default: Click — toggle / next (on a choice, the left half goes back). Double-click a slider to reset it (the white tick).
lyricfall.hint.demo: Shows a sample line right now so you can check the look.
lyricfall.hint.distance: How far from you the text floats. Farther looks calmer and does not block the view.
lyricfall.hint.follow: In front of your eyes, or stays in the world and does not turn with your head.
lyricfall.hint.height: Height relative to your eyes. Negative is lower.
lyricfall.hint.hide_on_tab: While Tab (player list) is held, the screen lyrics fade out.
lyricfall.hint.hide_with_gui: Hide the HUD while inventory or other menus are open.
lyricfall.hint.key: Click, then press a key. Esc cancels, Delete clears.
lyricfall.hint.kugou_lyrics: Fallback source of synced lyrics. Unofficial API: title, artist and duration are sent to KuGou servers (China).
lyricfall.hint.lines: How many lines karaoke shows at once.
lyricfall.hint.lyrics_accent: Highlight the current line with the accent color.
lyricfall.hint.lyrics_enter: How a line appears on screen: slide, rise letter by letter, pop or typewriter.
lyricfall.hint.lyrics_mode: Off, subtitles (current and next line) or karaoke (several lines scrolling).
lyricfall.hint.master: Turns the on-screen subtitles / karaoke on or off. Flying lyrics have their own switch.
lyricfall.hint.offset_x: Distance from the chosen edge, in pixels.
lyricfall.hint.offset_y: Distance from the chosen edge, in pixels.
lyricfall.hint.online_lyrics: Look up lyrics on lrclib.net and the databases below. Track title, artist and duration are sent there.
lyricfall.hint.open_folder: Put "Artist - Title.lrc" (or .txt) here to use your own lyrics. Own files always win.
lyricfall.hint.position: Pick where it sits on the screen. Fine-tune with the offsets below.
lyricfall.hint.reload: Forgets the lyrics of the current song and searches again.
lyricfall.hint.reset_hud: Puts every display setting back to defaults. Click twice.
lyricfall.hint.reset_keys: Puts all mod keys back to their defaults. Click twice.
lyricfall.hint.scale: Size of the element on screen.
lyricfall.hint.see_through: On: text is visible through walls. Off: walls hide it and text passes through them.
lyricfall.hint.shift: If lyrics are late, move to the minus; if they are early, move to the plus.
lyricfall.hint.text_shadow: Draw a shadow under the text for readability.
lyricfall.hint.width: Maximum width of the lyrics block.
lyricfall.hint.window_anim: How the mod windows open and close: zoom, slide, pop, old-TV unfold, or no animation.
lyricfall.hint.word_karaoke: Highlight words one by one when the lyrics have word timings.
lyricfall.hint.word_layout: All words of a line in a row, or every word at a random spot around you.
lyricfall.hint.world_enabled: Words of the song fly in the game world when they are sung. Needs lyrics with timings.
lyricfall.hint.world_mode: Near the player: text follows you. At the line spot: it stays where it appeared.
lyricfall.hint.world_spread: How far from the screen centre words may appear. Lower it if you play on a narrow or stretched screen and words fall off the edge.
lyricfall.hint.world_with_hud: Keep the on-screen subtitles or karaoke while the words fly in the world. Off by default.
lyricfall.note.keys: The keys are also listed in Minecraft's Controls menu under "Lyricfall".
lyricfall.note.world: Words of the song fly in the world when they are sung. Toggle with J, settings with K. Songs without timed lyrics show nothing in the world.
lyricfall.opt.lyricsmode.subtitle: Subtitles
lyricfall.set.hide_with_gui: Hide while a menu is open
lyricfall.status.hint: Start a song in the Spotify desktop app
lyricfall.status.lyrics.none: No lyrics found for this song
lyricfall.status.unsupported: Song detection only works on Windows
lyricfall.world.demo: This is how song words fly in the game, one by one, as they are sung
